label: The great betrayal: America turns its back on Israel
description: A word he says he gave earlier and was warned about again in March 2024: the United States turns its back on Israel, makes bad choices and withholds support, which opens an attack. He reports the Lord saying people will call it the great betrayal, and names it as a demonic assignment against America that prayer can stop.

label: Another 9/11-type event being planned in America
description: A Middle Eastern man with a large black beard, seen in vision, telling him that another 9/11-type event was being planned in America. He says he does not know whether it is already planned or how long such preparation takes.

label: Record heat and record wind gusts in the Northeast, summer 2024
description: Given 22 February 2024: record-breaking temperatures over the Philadelphia and New York area and the Northeast during the summer, lasting perhaps a week or a month, alongside record-breaking wind gusts, and an instruction to pay attention to the East where Chicago and Philadelphia were seen in headlines.
